name: Coinbase users phishing campaign
rootCause: Reports published in May 2025 described a coordinated social engineering campaign targeting Coinbase users through fake support calls, spoofed communications, and phishing infrastructure. Blockchain investigator ZachXBT stated that victims lost roughly $45 million in one week. Public evidence does not identify a single exploitable Coinbase smart contract or a complete set of attacker wallets and transactions. The reported losses resulted from social engineering and support impersonation scams that convinced users to disclose credentials, approve transactions, transfer assets, or install remote-access tooling.
